description: We are a multidisciplinary NASA Space Apps 2026 team of developers, designers, and STEM storytellers passionate about making space science accessible to young learners. Combining interactive audio transmissions, frequency-tuning gameplay, and real NASA mission telemetry, we built Ghost Rovers: Junior Space Detective to turn planetary archaeology into an engaging mission for explorers ages 8–14.
summary: An interactive space exploration game for ages 8–14 that lets young detectives tune deep-space radio frequencies, unlock first-person voice transmissions from 25 real NASA spacecraft left behind on the Moon, Mars, and deep space, decode simulated space ciphers, and master real mission telemetry.
details:
Spacecraft left behind across the solar system—from Apollo 11's Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector to Mars's Opportunity rover, InSight lander, Ingenuity helicopter, and interstellar Voyager 1—still hold extraordinary scientific stories. Ghost Rovers: Junior Space Detective turns planetary archaeology into a hands-on mission for learners ages 8–14.

Players explore 25 curated NASA mission dossiers across the Moon (9), Mars (9), and Deep Space (7). Using an interactive planetary radar and frequency tuner, explorers lock onto radio beacons (112–240 MHz) to unlock simulated first-person voice transmissions and Space Math telemetry cards. Learners then test their detective skills across a 53-question multi-format quiz engine, crack 10 cryptographic space puzzles (Caesar shifts, keyword substitutions, number-to-letter codes, and artifact riddles), and earn 10 persistent explorer badges saved offline in their browser.

Built as a fast, zero-backend React 19 and Vite 8 web application backed by 111 automated Vitest tests, the app runs seamlessly on desktop and mobile browsers and works fully offline once static assets load.

Please see the link to our GitHub repository: https://github.com/quilla-bit/ghost-rovers-space-detective.git
